entities.summary: Yuvan Shankar Raja, is an Indian composer and playback singer. He mainly scores music for Tamil films along with few Telugu, Kannada, and Hindi films. Considered a versatile composer, he is particularly known for his use of Western music elements and often credited with having introduced hip hop to the Tamil film and music industry and started the "era of remixes" in Tamil Nadu which included mixed EDM and jazz. He is frequently referred to as the "BGM King" of Tamil film music. Yuvan has won two Filmfare Awards South, five Mirchi Music Awards South, three Vijay Awards and two Tamil Nadu State Film Awards.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Yuvan Shankar Raja's influence on Tamil film music has been significant, with his use of Western music elements and introduction of hip hop leading to a shift in the industry's sound. He has won numerous awards for his work, including two Filmfare Awards South.
